intro: Sounds for the new Gulp, the Roll, the Clod Stomper and the ability ceremony (2026-10-09). The game already plays option A of each. Pick one per sound, or choose Neither and say how it should sound.

groups.name: Suck, catch and spit
groups.note: Q held sucks a thing in; it pops into the mouth; Q again spits it out as a throw.

groups.name: Thrown things breaking
groups.note: Each thing breaks by what it is made of: pots and shells as clay, jars, crystals and obsidian as glass, crates and logs as wood, kettles and lanterns as metal, rocks as stone, pumpkins, sacks, mud and snow as soft, ice as ice.

groups.name: The Roll
groups.note: Key 2: the ball spins in place like screeching tires, shoots off, and bonks into walls and bounces back.

groups.name: Learning an ability
groups.note: The ceremony when the slime learns something new.

options.label: Jelly vacuum
options.note: A rising airy suction whoosh with a gloopy wobble underneath

options.label: Whistling slurp
options.note: A high slurp through a straw, rising, with bubbly gurgles

cues.name: Catch
cues.where: The thing pops into the mouth

options.label: Gloop plop
options.note: A wet muffled squishy pop with a short wobble

options.label: Cork plunk
options.note: A hollow plunk into thick jelly and a tiny bubbly wobble

cues.name: Spit
cues.where: Q again: the thing flies out

options.label: Ptoo
options.note: Puffed cheeks bursting in a quick wet blow and a whoosh

options.label: Boing pop
options.note: A springy jelly pop that launches it, then a short whoosh

options.label: Pot shatter
options.note: A sharp ceramic crack and scattering shards

options.label: Jar pop and tinkle
options.note: A hollow ceramic pop, then little bits tinkling as they settle

options.label: Glass shatter
options.note: A bright glass break with tinkling bits

options.label: Crate smash
options.note: Splintering planks cracking and clattering

options.label: Clang
options.note: A metallic clang and a short rattling bounce

cues.name: Stone
cues.where: Rocks, bricks, urns of stone, coral

options.label: Rock crack
options.note: A crunchy stone crack and a scatter of gravel

cues.name: Soft
cues.where: Pumpkins, cabbages, sacks, mud, snow, thrown essences

options.label: Splat
options.note: A wet splat with a soft puff of air

cues.name: Ice
cues.where: Ice blocks, icicles, frost crystals, frosted jars

options.label: Ice shatter
options.note: A crisp icy crack and tinkling shards

cues.name: Spin-up
cues.where: The ball spins in place before it shoots off

options.label: Squeaky screech
options.note: A rubbery tire screech rising in pitch

options.label: Peel-out
options.note: A cartoon wind-up whirr with squeaky skidding, like feet spinning before a dash

options.label: Zip
options.note: A short bright airy swoosh

options.label: Boing whoosh
options.note: A springy boing stretching into a fast whoosh

cues.name: Bonk
cues.where: The ball hits a wall and bounces back

options.label: Thud bonk
options.note: A heavy thud with a cartoon bonk and a springy wobble

options.label: Crash and boing
options.note: A dull thump, pebbles rattling down, a boing as it bounces back

cues.name: Slam
cues.where: The Clod Stomper lands its stomp

options.label: Mud stomp
options.note: A heavy squelchy thump with a rocky crunch and a rumble

cues.name: Ceremony
cues.where: The slime learns a new ability

options.label: Harp and bells
options.note: A rising harp glissando into bright chimes and a bubbly pop

options.label: Marimba jingle
options.note: A cheerful marimba and glockenspiel jingle with a rising bubble
